items.summary: printing-press-amend turns real CLI usage friction into pull requests for published printing-press library CLIs. Two input modes feed a unified finding list: dogfood mode mines the active Claude Code session transcript for missing flags, hand-rolled API payloads, and silent-null returns, while direct-input mode accepts explicit rename, add, fix, or sniff requests with optional site endpoint discovery. Phase 0 detects MODE as dogfood, direct, both, or asks the user when ambiguous, persisting mode.txt under PRESS_RUNSTATE. Setup runs the PRESS_SETUP_CONTRACT to resolve PRINTING_PRESS_BIN absolute path, enforce min-binary-version 4.0.0, and hard-stop below the published currency floor from supported-versions.txt. Patches track in the library .printing-press-patches directory, distinct from the binary patch subcommand AST injection. Sibling skills publish, polish, and retro cover other lifecycle stages not addressed here.

items.name: entity-optimizer
items.author: aaron-he-zhu
items.description: Systematically strengthen how search engines and AI systems understand and surface their brand or product entity.
items.summary: Entity Optimizer audits, builds, and maintains entity identity across search engines and AI systems for brands, people, organizations, and products. Google's Knowledge Graph powers Knowledge Panels and entity-based ranking, while AI systems resolve queries to entities before generating answers. If an AI cannot identify an entity, it cannot cite it regardless of content quality. The skill maps six signal categories totaling forty-seven signals, scores each Pass, Fail, or Partial, runs an AI entity resolution test across ChatGPT, Claude, Perplexity, and Google AI Overview, and produces a gap analysis, building plan, and disambiguation strategy. Workflows start with entity discovery across Knowledge Panel, Wikidata, Wikipedia, and schema.org, continue through structured data, knowledge base, NAP+E consistency, content-based, third-party, and AI-specific signals, and finish with a canonical entity profile and top five priority actions. Optional local helper kg.py reconciles entity names to Wikidata QIDs without API keys. Primary handoff goes to schema-markup-generator after entity truth is established.
highlights: Scores 47 entity signals across 6 categories from structured data through AI-specific recognition
Runs AI entity resolution tests for ChatGPT, Claude, Perplexity, and Google AI Overview
Produces canonical entity profiles following the entity-geo handoff schema for downstream skills
Includes zero-dependency kg.py helper to reconcile names to Wikidata QIDs with confidence scores

items.summary: UI/UX Pro Max is a design intelligence skill for planning, building, reviewing, and improving premium web and mobile interfaces. Its core philosophy rejects uniform AI-generated layouts: decide one hero per section, cut elements before coding, make one element 120 points while others sit at 60, and criticize with three problems before proposing fixes. The premium formula favors large imagery occupying 70-85% of cards, bold 112px section spacing, and minimal decoration over gradients or glow orbs. Implementation rules require project globals.css design tokens instead of raw Tailwind defaults, WCAG 2.1 contrast of 4.5:1 for normal text, multilingual typography tokens for Japanese and English, Lucide icons only, and Lighthouse accessibility target of 100%. Covers landing pages, dashboards, SaaS products, responsive mobile apps, image-first editorial layouts, dark mode, primary white CTAs, and explicit bans on violet gradients, glassmorphism defaults, and hover scale tricks. Escalation protocol maps user phrases from micro-adjustments to full Spitfire-level redesigns.

Premium formula: large imagery, 112px section spacing, decoration subtracted not added

items.name: twilio sms automation
items.author: claude-office-skills
items.description: Automate customer notifications, two-factor authentication, order updates, and voice-based workflows via Twilio without writing custom API glue.
items.summary: twilio-sms-automation is a Claude Office Skills communication workflow that routes agent tasks through a communication-mcp server with four Twilio tools: twilio_send_sms, twilio_voice_call, twilio_lookup, and twilio_verify. It covers outbound and inbound SMS, scripted voice calls, phone number validation and formatting, templated personalization, and two-factor verification flows. Inputs include destination phone numbers, message bodies, call scripts, and verification codes; outputs include delivery status, call recordings, lookup results, verification outcomes, and analytics-style reports. The skill targets operational alerts such as order updates, authentication codes, and customer notifications without hand-writing Twilio REST client boilerplate for each workflow. Recommended models include Claude Sonnet 4 and Opus 4 with compatibility for Claude 3.5 Sonnet, GPT-4, and GPT-4o. Related skills include WhatsApp and Slack automation for multi-channel messaging. Agents invoke MCP tools directly rather than maintaining one-off curl examples for every messaging scenario.

Covers SMS send and receive, voice call scripts, number lookup, and 2FA verification.

items.name: laravel-plugin-discovery
items.author: affaan-m
items.description: Quickly discover, evaluate health, and verify Laravel version compatibility of PHP packages before adding them to a project.
items.summary: Laravel Plugin Discovery enables developers to find and assess Laravel packages through the LaraPlugins.io MCP server without requiring API keys. Developers use it when selecting dependencies for features like authentication, permissions, or admin panels, needing to verify package health, maintenance status, and Laravel/PHP version compatibility before integration. The skill provides two core workflows: searching packages by keyword with filters for health score (Healthy/Medium/Unhealthy), Laravel versions 5-13, PHP versions 7.4-8.5, and vendor reputation; and retrieving detailed package metrics including health indicators, last activity dates, version history, and risk scores. Best practices emphasize filtering by health status for production use, matching target Laravel versions, checking vendor reputation, and reviewing comprehensive details before recommending packages to teams. Search packages by keyword, health band (Healthy/Medium/Unhealthy), Laravel version, PHP version, and vendor name via SearchPluginTool
